# Copilot instructions

Read [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) first: it lists the build/test commands, the
module layout, the invariants changes must preserve (positional row pairing,
L2 normalization, `>=` heat threshold, `i`/`score`/`p` output keys), and the
verification loop.

Run `scripts/verify.sh` before proposing a change is complete.
